candidates.anchor_quote: En Playwright real activas tracing alrededor del flujo crítico y abres el zip en Trace Viewer; en el lab modelamos las mismas keys.
candidates.ui: Playwright Trace Viewer (web app local que abre el trace.zip)
candidates.why: El lab solo modela las keys del paquete; el estudiante nunca ve qué ofrece el zip al abrirlo. Sin ver el layout (lista de acciones, snapshot Before/After, pestañas Errors/Console/Network) no sabe dónde buscar si la falla fue de selector, red o timeout, que es justo la decisión que pide el bloque.
candidates.image_shows: Playwright Trace Viewer in a browser tab (localhost:9323/trace). Top: timeline with filmstrip thumbnails. Left: Actions/Metadata tabs with steps (Before Hooks, Navigate to "/", Click getByRole('link', { name: 'star' }) highlighted in red, After Hooks, Attach "error-context", Worker Cleanup) with durations. Centre: Action/Before/After tabs with a DOM snapshot of playwright.dev. Bottom: tabs Locator, Call, Log, Errors (1), Console, Network (31), Source, Attachments (1); the Errors tab is open showing 'Error: locator.click: Error: strict mode violation: getByRole('link', { name: 'star' }) resolved to 5 elements' with the candidate elements listed. The test file is JavaScript (example.spec.ts), not Python.
candidates.crop_suggestion: Crop away the outer browser chrome (tab strip and address bar, roughly the top 120 px at displayed scale / ~240 px original), which also removes a tiny user avatar icon at top right; keep from the black 'Playwright' header to the bottom of the error panel. 4032x2244 original: downscale to ~1600 px wide.
candidates.alt_es: Captura de Playwright Trace Viewer. Arriba, una línea de tiempo con miniaturas de la página. A la izquierda, la lista Actions con el paso Click getByRole('link', { name: 'star' }) marcado en rojo. Al centro, la instantánea de la página con pestañas Action, Before y After. Abajo, la pestaña Errors abierta muestra «strict mode violation»: el locator resolvió a 5 elementos.
candidates.caption_es: Trace Viewer de Playwright con una prueba fallida: el paso en rojo, la página en ese instante y el error del locator en la pestaña Errors. La imagen oficial usa un test en JavaScript; con Python el visor es el mismo.

alternates.note: Same viewer on a passing test, Source tab open. Not preferred: the block is about failures, and the Source panel shows a local path containing a person's name ('/Users/debbieobrien/...'), which would need cropping.

considered_and_rejected.reason: No graphical interface; all outputs are printed arrays, which stay as text.
No GUI step; 'abrir Excel' in the intro is a contrast, not an instruction to operate Excel.
No GUI; existing SVG figures cover the concepts.
No GUI; existing SVG figures cover merge and melt/pivot.

considered_and_rejected.where: S18-T4-B Notebook reproducible y data notes
considered_and_rejected.reason: The block is about reproducibility contracts, not about operating Jupyter; a notebook screenshot would be decorative.

considered_and_rejected.where: S19-T3-A Filtros, tooltips y vista interactiva
considered_and_rejected.reason: The block explicitly says no Plotly or Streamlit is needed and models the view as a data spec; no UI to operate.
The point is that the script must not need Excel opened; the existing SVG covers sheet layout. An Excel screenshot would be decorative, and Microsoft UI images have no permissive licence.
Verification is programmatic (ZIP signature, extracted headings, rendered PNG); 'se veía bien en Word' is cited as non-evidence. No UI step.

considered_and_rejected.where: S22-T2-A OAuth, service account y scopes
considered_and_rejected.reason: Lab uses synthetic capabilities and states it is not a real OAuth flow; a Google consent-screen screenshot would mislead, and Google UI images are not under an allowed licence.

considered_and_rejected.where: S23-T1-A DOM y locators (Pick locator / codegen)
considered_and_rejected.reason: Playwright's codegen/pick-locator images (Apache-2.0) exist, but the block never asks the learner to use those tools; adding them would introduce a tool the prose does not teach.
No GUI; OCR outputs are text/JSON and preprocessing is covered by SVG figures.

considered_and_rejected.where: S25-T1-B Model cards, licencias y decisión local o cloud ('lee la model card')
considered_and_rejected.reason: A Hub model-page screenshot would help, but the official images live in the huggingface/documentation-images dataset, licensed cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 (NonCommercial). hub-docs repo (Apache-2.0) has no such image in-repo. Blocked by licence.

considered_and_rejected.where: S26-T1-A DAG y estados / S26-T3-A HITL
considered_and_rejected.reason: Implemented 'sin Prefect/Airflow instalado'; the dashboard is described, not operated. Existing SVG S26-dag-states covers the states. An orchestrator UI screenshot would show a tool the learner does not use.
